qs.q:
Anyone for Shopping? — Which person…

A=Alex (loves shopping malls, looks for price reductions especially jeans/shoes, sometimes buys nothing, loves atmosphere)
B=Bruno (loves hanging out in malls but can't stand shops, thinks people waste money, loves cafés and bars)
C=Chris (shopping as retail therapy/stress relief, likes to go alone, always buys clothing, friends think she's extravagant)
D=Diana (takes kids to cinema after shopping, kids love the malls, crowds, spends a lot but feels bought nothing)
E=Ed (prefers local shop, too crowded in supermarkets, hates big stores, chats with the owner)
F=Fran (stressed when shopping with kids, they always want things, prefers going without them)

0. looks out for things that are cheaper than usual? [A=Alex: price reductions]
1. finds it crowded where they shop?
2. can find going to stores stressful?
3. always buys some clothing?
4. likes to combine shopping with another activity?
5. goes to shopping centres for social reasons?
6. often buys things that they don't need?
7. can't stand waiting in stores?
8. dislikes going to shops?
9. sometimes buys nothing when they go shopping?
10. prefers to shop on their own?
11. likes the appearance of where they shop?
12. prefers a personal atmosphere?
items: 1 — finds it crowded where they shop?
2 — can find going to stores stressful?
4 — likes to combine shopping with another activity?
5 — goes to shopping centres for social reasons?
6 — often buys things that they don't need?
9 — sometimes buys nothing when they go shopping?
10 — prefers to shop on their own?
11 — likes the appearance of where they shop?

Adam Walker – Celebrity Chef

"I was FASCINATED BY IT ALL... Everyone was really FRIENDLY TOO."

What did Adam enjoy most about working in his uncle's restaurant?
A He made some good friends.
B He saw some famous people.
C The money was very good.
D There was a great atmosphere.

Adam Walker

"The really TOUGH BIT was the PRACTICAL PART of the course. This was when we had to go and WORK IN A KITCHEN."

What did Adam find to be the hardest thing about studying to be a chef?
A Being tired all the time.
B Doing work experience.
C Friends making fun of him.
D Having no free time.

Adam Walker

"Italy's an amazing place. I WISH I HAD TRAVELLED ROUND MORE."

When he thinks about his time in Italy, Adam regrets not…
A buying a property there.
B learning Italian better.
C seeing more of the country.
D staying there longer.

Adam Walker

"Living abroad makes you appreciate your OWN CULTURE MORE, so I decided I'd do something on OUR NATIONAL CUISINE."

What is Adam's book about?
A British dishes.
B Eating cheaply.
C Healthy eating.
D Preparing seafood.

Adam Walker

"A friend who works in TV TURNED UP TO INTERVIEW ME about my book... when I was having this FURIOUS ARGUMENT with one of the waiters."

The people from the TV company got the idea for a show about Adam…
A by chance.
B from his book.
C from other shows.
D through a friend.

Adam Walker

"I'm on my feet all day, but I've GOT NO REGRETS."

Which of the following would Adam say about his career?
A 'I'm doing something I've wanted to do ever since I was a small child.'
B 'It's been great fun and I've had a lot of laughs over the years.'
C 'It's been brilliant, but I sometimes wish I had done something else.'
D 'To get to the top, I found hard work to be more important than qualifications.'
opts: 'I'm doing something I've wanted to do ever since I was a small child.'
'It's been great fun and I've had a lot of laughs over the years.'
'It's been brilliant, but I sometimes wish I had done something else.'
'To get to the top, I found hard work to be more important than qualifications.'

qs.q:
Shark Attack!

"I screamed to the guys in the boat to get Stan out. (19) ____. It worked. But now the fin turned and came towards me."

A It was my brother who said to me that I could achieve anything I wanted.
B I remember seeing them screaming back in total panic.
C I could feel my body moving farther from its mouth as its teeth slid down the bone.
D I had been dragged about 50m under water and when I broke the surface I was close to blacking out.
E As they headed for him, I knew I had to do something to distract the shark, so I started slapping the water.
F As I went down, my lungs felt as if they were on fire.
G I was hitting it so much that when I reached hospital, there was no skin left on my knuckles.
H I thought I was going to die.
opts: A — brother said I could achieve anything
B — I remember seeing them screaming in total panic
C — body moving farther as teeth slid down the bone
D — dragged under water, close to blacking out
E — As they headed for him, I started slapping the water to distract the shark
F — As I went down, my lungs were on fire
G — no skin left on my knuckles
H — I thought I was going to die
